generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Prices: Quoted price shall be inclusive of Packing & Forwarding, Provident Fund & exclusive of GST. The statutory levies such as IT etc., will be recovered at prevailing applicable rates from the bills. Please furnish registration copies of IT PAN, GSTIN, and Independent PF code. Quoted basic rates shall be FIRM throughout the period of contract. Any subsequent variations in taxes and duties shall be to the account of KPCL. No extra charges will be paid on account of price variation of material and labour etc. No price variation will be allowed whether in cost/labour/ materials or any other factors affecting process or services
Terms of Payment: 100 % Payment will be made in the form of NEFT/ RTGS after satisfactory completion and handing over of work. Contractor shall furnish his bank account details along with Invoice

EMD- EMD as indicated in the memorandum shall be paid online through KPP portal. a. The bidder may note the fact that their registration with any other authority does not entitle them for exemption from payment of EMD. b. If the bidder has not furnished the requisite EMD in the specified form as mentioned above, the said tender will be rejected. c. The Bidder or the tenderer is liable to be Blacklisted- i) If he withdraws his tender within the validity period as indicated in the memorandum or fails to execute the work after acceptance of the tender or fails to submit the Security Deposit. ii) If he revises any of the terms quoted during the validity period. iii) If, any of the document / information furnished by the bidder is found to be false after submission of the tender. d. Validity of EMD shall be 210 days

Security Deposit (SD)/ Contract Performance Guarantee: i) The successful bidder shall deposit security deposit within 20 days from the date of issue of work order in the form of e-BG drawn in favour of Karnataka Power Corporation Limited, RTPS, Shaktinagar, on any Nationalized Bank, for an amount equivalent to 5 percent of the contract amount. (plus, additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with KTPP act). This Deposit shall not carry any interest. The KPCL reserves the right to forfeit the SD in case of any breach of contract. If the contractor fails to start the work as stipulated, the EMD and the SD shall be forfeited. ii) Security deposit shall be refunded after completion of the contract period including guarantee period subject to clearance of all dues and to the satisfaction of the KPCL. If KPCL incur any loss or damage on account of non-fulfilment of obligations under this contract, then such losses / damages incurred by KPCL shall be deducted from the security deposit. The amount so deducted / adjusted shall not be refunded to the tenderer.iii) If the whole or a part of the EMD / security deposit is adjusted / attached by KPCL for any default of tenderer in the due fulfilment of the contract during the contract period, then the contractor shall immediately arrange to replenish the amount of security deposit so attached / adjusted for the continued operation of the contract, failing which the contract is liable for termination by KPCL, the responsibility for which shall wholly rest with the tenderer.iv) In the event of any upward revision in the value of the contract arising on account of increase in the schedule of works, the KPCL reserves the right to call for additional security deposit amount and agency shall, on receiving intimation from the KPCL, increase the security deposit suitably as may be directed by the KPCL within 30 days.v) All compensations or other sums of money payable by the Contractor/agency, under the terms of this contract may be deducted from his security deposit or from any sums that may be due, or may become due to the Contractor by the Corporation on any account whatsoever and in the event of security deposit being reduced by reason of any such deduction, the Contractor shall, within 10 days thereafter make good the shortfall in the security deposit referred to above. vi)The agency shall use the following beneficiary details for e-BG: Beneficiary Entity PAN- AAACK8032D. Beneficiary Entity Name: Karnataka Power Corporation Ltd. Beneficiary name:EE(CHP)E-1/RTPS
All the General terms and conditions, special conditions, Rights of KPCL, Safety & Security, Statutory rules and regulations etc., as specified in the tender document

Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Supply, Erection and Commissioning of Polygon high mast with fittings and wiring, of value not less than Rs. 14.40 lakhs in the last five years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) in any thermal power stations. As a proof of this, the bidder should upload a single work order and corresponding work done certificate issued by the competent authority. (Work done of Previous years shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year).
Intending Bidder shall be Class-I or above electrical contractor. As a proof of this, valid Electrical license issued by competent authority of Govt. of Karnataka shall be furnished

The intending bidder in his name should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 28.80 Lakhs in any two financial years during the last five years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload the certified copy of the Profit and Loss or Turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered Accountant. (financial turnover of previous years shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year).

itemList.description: Fabrication, Supplying, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of ...... ms long Polygon high mast with Single/Multiple telescopic sections having, (minimum overlap distance of 1.5 times of top section) thickness as per BSEN 10025 grades 355 JO/ASTM A572-50 steel sheet plate for shaft suitable to withstand a wind velocity of 47 m/s as per IS 875 part 3(as per GA Drawing). Base plate as per IS 2062/ASTM A572-50. The mast shall be Galvanized in single Hot-dip as per BSEN ISO 1461/ASTM A123 with an average 70 microns as per IS 2629, and welded as per BS 5135 Single L-Seam joint The mast shall have 2 Way head frame with die cast LM-6 pulleys, stainless steel axle, Phosphorus Bronze bearing bush press- fitted with separate guides for 2 runs of 5 mm dia, stainless steel wire rope of AISI 304grade 7/19-core, (Factor of Safety as per TR no-7). 2.5 mm2 EPR insulated PCP sheathed trailing power cable housed inside the bottom shaft of mast with door having locking arrangement The mast shall have manual/power tool (Suitable reversible geared motor operating on 230/415V, 50Hz, shall be provide above 15 Mtr mast) The mast shall have lantern of 2 segments, suitable dia with max load carrying capacity as per IS 1239. The mast shall be erected on existing RCC footing. The mast shall be supplied with 3 mm thick template, lightning arrester of 1.2m length galvanized pipe with top arrow fitted on top of the head frame cover and GLS type aviation twin l A fitting with wiring complete. (excluding foundation) as per technical data. 25 m - Top150 mm and Bottom 540 mm dia
